title: Get Down
lyrics: Verse 1:
[B5]Lavishly our lives are wasted, [D5]humbleness is left untasted,
[G5]You can't live your life to please your[D]self, yeah;
[B5]That's a tip from my mistake, e[D5]xactly what it doesn't take,
To [G5]win you've got to come in last[B5] place.[A5]
To [D]live your life you've [E]got to lose it, And[Gmaj7] all the losers [D]get a crown.
Chorus 1:
I get [D]down, and He lifts me up, I get [E7]down, and He lifts me up,
I get [G]down, and He lifts me up,
I get [D]down.
Verse 2:
[B5]All I need's another day where [D5]I can't seem to get away
[G5]From the many things that drag me [D]down, yeah;
I'm [B5]sure you've had a day like me where [D5]nothing seems to set you free,
From the [G5]burdens you can't carry all a[B5]lone.[A5]
[D]In your weakness [E]He is stronger, [Gmaj7]In your darkness [D]He shines through;
[D]When you're crying [E7]He's your comfort, When you're [G]all alone He's [D]carrying you.
Bridge 1:
[Bm]This valley [D] is so deep, [G] I can barely see the [D]sun;
[Bm]I cry out [D] for mercy Lord, [G] And You lift me up a[B5]gain.[A5]
artist: Mark Stuart, Ben Cissell, Bob Herdman, Tyler Burkum, Will McGinniss
